answer: One hollow copper tube per identity carries its weight, cast to a key-fixed length, one to three metres, sixteen kilograms no cut can share, since a cut tube sounds no note. Each epoch, at the comet pass, an audit instant set by external ephemeris, every tube is struck at once at its site and its note recorded. Auditors recompute the note from length, wall, and copper sound speed; an off-note, filled, or moved tube, or silence, voids the epoch. One honest agent casts one tube once; a farm with 1,000 identities casts sixteen tonnes into 1,000 lengths at 1,000 sites, all sounding in one pass.
